title: Connections: Lab Partners
desc: Find the scientific thread linking each set of clues

questions.q: What connects: GPS satellites, airplane altimeters, and your ageing process?
questions.a: Einstein's relativity — GPS corrects for time dilation, altimeters use atmospheric pressure (affected by gravity), and you age faster on a mountaintop than at sea level (by nanoseconds)

questions.q: What connects: a frog in boiling water, the 10% brain myth, and lemmings jumping off cliffs?
questions.a: They're all scientific myths — frogs do jump out, we use all our brain, and lemmings don't mass-suicide (that was faked for a Disney documentary)

questions.q: Odd one out: Helium, Neon, Argon, Nitrogen. Which and why?
questions.a: Nitrogen — the other three are noble gases (Group 18, very unreactive). Nitrogen is in Group 15 and bonds readily

questions.q: What connects: Dolly the Sheep, Henrietta Lacks, and Rosalind Franklin?
questions.a: Groundbreaking contributions to genetics — Dolly (first cloned mammal), Lacks (her cells revolutionised medical research), Franklin (her X-ray crystallography was key to discovering DNA's structure)

questions.q: Put these in order from smallest to largest: atom, molecule, cell, virus
questions.a: Atom → molecule → virus → cell (viruses are smaller than cells but larger than most molecules)

questions.q: What connects: the Haber process, Agent Orange, and leaded petrol?
questions.a: Scientific innovations that caused massive environmental or human harm — nitrogen fixation enabled explosives, Agent Orange defoliated Vietnam, and leaded petrol poisoned generations

questions.q: Name that element: it's in your bones, your phone screen, in matches, and is essential for DNA
What connects: a black hole, the bottom of the ocean, and the centre of the Earth?
questions.a: We've never directly observed any of them — we infer their properties indirectly through measurements, imaging, and theory

questions.q: True, false, or it depends: 'We evolved from monkeys'
questions.a: It depends on what you mean — we share a common ancestor with modern apes (not monkeys), but we didn't descend from any species alive today

questions.q: What connects: butterfly wings, soap bubbles, and oil slicks?
questions.a: Structural colour / thin-film interference — the colours come from light wave interference, not pigment
